controls: Minimum scope profiles are fixed for TikTok, Douyin, both supported Instagram login paths and YouTube Shorts.
OAuth state is random, hashed at rest, single-use, expiring and bound to tenant, actor, platform, profile and exact allowlisted redirect URI.
PKCE S256 verifier remains encrypted server-side and is released only to the injected token exchange.
Access and refresh tokens use AES-256-GCM with per-record IV and purpose-bound authenticated data.
Public binding/list/disconnect results never contain credential envelopes or plaintext tokens.
Returned grants must exactly match the requested minimum scopes; missing or expanded grants fail closed.
Bindings are tenant-scoped; reconnecting the same external account reuses its identity.
Near-expiry refresh is single-flight, preserves scope and keeps refresh-token rotation encrypted.
Disconnect attempts remote revocation when supported and removes local usable credentials even if revocation fails.
Encrypted snapshots support restart without persisting OAuth codes, plaintext tokens or plaintext PKCE verifiers.
boundary: The implementation is a server-side domain module with injected platform transports. No route or live provider adapter is enabled and no local test constitutes real account authorization.
